messages.subject: PyStan testing OS X gcc and clang
parts:

{Python 2.7, Python 3.3, Python 3.4}:

https://travis-ci.org/stan-dev/pystan

Now if we can just get Windows in there...

Best,

-a

messages.author: 17d9c7a6e1a581b8
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] PyStan testing OS X gcc and clang
parts:
You need to do some tricks to break up the tests, e.g., run 1/4th of the tests
at a time. PyStan does this. It's easy if you can exclude/include tests with an
environment variable that the test suite picks up.

Best,

-a
